source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Follow the instructions in each section to see which violations apply. 3. Read the reporting requirements outlined at the bottom of the document. 4. Contact us if you have questions.

Which inspection violations require notifying the public?

Each violation listed below has reporting requirements to protect public health. An inspection may result in more than one violation. Determine if the violation: * Was caused by outside incidents or failures (i.e. outside the water system’s control) such as weather or natural disasters. * Did not correct the deficiency within 72 hours. If yes to either question, it is a HEALTH-BASED VIOLATION and REQUIRES YOU TO NOTIFY THE PUBLIC. If NO, the deficiency needs to be corrected within 72 hours of discovering the violation. No public notification is required.
